name: truthlensflask
description: TruthLens 템플릿용 Tailwind CSS 빌드 도구

scripts.css:base: tailwindcss -c tailwind.base.config.js -i tools/tailwind-entry.css -o static/css/tailwind.base.css && postcss static/css/tailwind.base.css --replace --no-map
scripts.css:login: tailwindcss -c tailwind.login.config.js -i tools/tailwind-entry.css -o static/css/tailwind.login.css && postcss static/css/tailwind.login.css --replace --no-map
scripts.css: npm run css:base && npm run css:login
